name: 112-robust-eos-skip-lands-in-tail
description: Robustness: sleep at end of section is on, then a skip lands in the closing silence of segment 0 (2.71 s heading, ends a section): 2.2 s, past its 0.9 s stop point. The section still ends 0.5 s later, so the player must stop there (SleepFired, parked at the start of 1), not play on through segments 1 to 15.
